findings.quote: St. Kitts and Nevis welcomes the Independent International Scientific Panel on Artificial Intelligence and the Global Dialogue on AI Governance.
findings.rationale: Advocates inclusive AI governance, national and regional adoption, infrastructure, skills and rights safeguards.

findings.quote: AI, the green transition, and climate change are reshaping their future jobs. We must prepare them.
